pregnancy_by_week.10: You've reached 10 weeks, and your little one is now officially a fetus! This is a major milestone as all their essential organs have formed. Many people find their early pregnancy symptoms start to ease up around now.
pregnancy_by_week.12: You've reached the end of the first trimester! Many people find their energy levels start to return this week.
pregnancy_by_week.16: Your baby's sensory development is kicking into high gear. They can now make sucking motions with their mouth.
pregnancy_by_week.26: At 26 weeks, your baby's eyes are starting to open and they are becoming more sensitive to sound. This is a great time to talk or sing to your baby! It's also a good time to discuss the upcoming glucose screening test with your doctor.
pregnancy_by_week.27: Welcome to the home stretch—the third trimester begins next week! Your baby is practicing breathing by inhaling and exhaling amniotic fluid, which is helping their lungs develop.
pregnancy_by_week.32: Your baby is practicing breathing by inhaling amniotic fluid. You're in the home stretch!
pregnancy_by_week.default: While I don't have a specific update for this week, development is happening every day! It's always best to discuss your baby's specific progress with your healthcare provider.

cycle_phases.menstruation: Your cycle has begun. It's a great time to focus on rest, gentle movement, and nourishing foods.
cycle_phases.follicular: As your energy returns after your period, you might find it's a great time for more active workouts.
cycle_phases.ovulation: You might be feeling a peak in your energy and mood around now. This is the fertile window of your cycle.
cycle_phases.luteal: As your body prepares for your next period, you might notice PMS symptoms. Gentle exercise and mindfulness can be very helpful now.
